description: Local-first Android workout tracker for training programs, readiness, live workout logging, progression, rest timing, history, cardio, volume analysis, and JSON export.

navigation.type: Enum-based Compose navigation in MainActivity; no Navigation Compose graph.
behavior: Android back from a non-home tab returns to Home.
The bottom navigation is hidden while an active workout session is open.
Rest-timer notification actions can open the workout screen and adjust or skip the timer.

screens.name: Protocol / Home
functionalities: Shows the selected gym, settings access, recommended next workout, last workout, recovery days, and fatigue status.
Starts the recommended or selected non-rest program day after collecting readiness input.
Shows progress and a resume action when a workout is already active.
Lists weekly program days and allows starting a day or adding an exercise to a day.
Creates a custom training program with a seven-day split, or loads the Nick Walker reconstruction template when there is no program.
Adds catalog exercises to a program day by searching/filtering by muscle group, choosing an available equipment variant, and selecting Add to Program.
Creates a custom exercise equipment variant with name, manufacturer, resistance type, seat, and handle details.
Displays exercise and machine catalog counts in the no-program state.
dialogs: System readiness: sleep, energy, soreness, joint discomfort, and motivation; displays a fatigue warning based on the entered values.
Gym picker: selects the active gym facility.
Settings and data export: creates and shares a JSON analysis export.
Create program: enters a program title and description, then initializes the default weekly split.
Add exercise: searches catalog exercises, filters by muscle, selects a variant, and adds it to the selected day.
Create custom variant: defines equipment-specific setup for an exercise.

screens.name: Session / Active Workout
screens.navigation: Bottom tab, Home resume/start actions, or rest-timer notification intent
functionalities: Resumes the persisted active session and displays its exercises, current exercise, prescribed work sets, rep range, RIR, progression target, and previous performance.
Switches between exercises and indicates exercise completion progress.
Logs warm-up and work sets with load, reps, RIR, intensity technique, and optional drop-set or rest-pause segments.
Shows a plate estimate based on a 20 kg bar and the selected load.
Displays and allows editing of exercise setup (seat position, handle position, gym notes) and execution cues.
Collects post-set execution quality and target-muscle sensation feedback.
Displays recorded sets, personal-record markers, and permits deleting sets.
Runs a persisted rest timer with recommended duration, play/pause, -15 and +30 second adjustment, skip, sound/notification toggle, and completion haptic feedback.
Finishes the session with bodyweight and session notes, then saves and audits progression.
Discards an active workout after confirmation.
dialogs: Free session: starts an ad-hoc workout with a custom title and selected catalog exercises.
Intensity segments: adds or removes drop-set/rest-pause segments and records load, reps, and rest duration.
Progression explanation: explains the double-progression target and load increase conditions.
Finish session: records bodyweight and workout notes before saving.
Discard session: confirms removal of the active session.
empty_states: With no active session, offers navigation to Protocols, a free-session start action, and a link to workout history.
If an active session has no exercises, offers discard and navigation back to Protocols.

screens.name: History
screens.navigation: Bottom tab or links from the workout empty state and workout screen
functionalities: Provides three internal views: workout timeline, exercise history, and calendar.
Shows workout history loading and error states, with retry on error.
Opens a completed workout detail or an exercise history detail.

subviews.name: Workouts
functionalities: Searches and filters completed workouts by title, date range (7 or 30 days), and personal records.
Browses workouts by month and groups results by today, yesterday, this week, or month.
Shows workout duration, exercise and set counts, volume, and PR count; opens session detail.

subviews.name: Exercises
functionalities: Searches exercises in completed workout history.
Sorts by most recent, name, most used, or greatest progress.
Shows session count, latest and best set, and estimated one-rep max; opens exercise detail.

subviews.name: Calendar
functionalities: Browses workout months and marks calendar days that contain sessions.
Selects a date and lists its completed workouts; opens session detail.

subviews.name: Completed Workout Detail
functionalities: Shows workout date, duration, sets, reps, volume, PRs, exercise notes, warm-ups, work sets, intensity techniques, and set segments.
Compares exercise sets with the previous performance and compares the workout with the previous equivalent session.
Shows workout notes, associated cardio entries, and session totals.
Opens the completed-workout editor.

subviews.name: Exercise History Detail
functionalities: Shows latest performance, best load, estimated one-rep max, and number of sessions.
Charts evolution by estimated one-rep max, weight, volume, or reps.
Lists personal records and workout-by-workout set history; opens the associated workout detail.

screens.name: Edit Completed Workout
screens.navigation: Opened from a completed workout detail; shown as a full-screen overlay.
functionalities: Edits the completed workout title and notes.
Edits each recorded set's weight, reps, and RIR with input validation.
Saves changes to the workout draft or cancels editing.
Prompts before discarding unsaved edits.

screens.name: Cardio
functionalities: Logs cardio sessions for Stairmaster, Incline Walk, Treadmill, or Bike.
Records duration, level/incline, average heart rate, RPE, and notes, then saves the cardio log.
Lists prior cardio sessions with machine, duration, level, heart rate, RPE, and timestamp.

screens.name: System Metrics & Volume
screens.navigation: Not connected to MainActivity navigation; no in-app route was found.
screens.reachability: Declared in the source tree but not currently reachable through the shipped screen navigation.
functionalities: Presents a fatigue accumulation diagnostic card and protocol recommendation chips.
Displays direct and indirect hard-set volume by muscle group for a seven-day period.
Shows examples of load, rep, and technique personal-record comparisons.
The current volume rows and PR examples are hard-coded sample presentation data in this screen.

global_features: Workout sessions, exercises, sets, progression targets, exercise index, and rest-timer state are persisted through Room-backed flows.
Rest timer service and notifications support opening the workout, adding timer time, and skipping the timer.
Workout completion records the completed session and updates progression/history data.
Settings data export shares a JSON snapshot containing workouts, sets, program, bodyweight, cardio, and recovery information.
